observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The original photos still only show a Porsche-branded engine/drivetrain assembly on the ground; no readable engine/gearbox code, VIN, or test documentation is visible.
The seller’s new message is only text; it does not add remote-verifiable evidence.

claims.evidence: No shipping/import documents, labels, or VIN/part-number tags visible in the photos.
Seller text claims testing; photos show no start-up/video/sound recording or test sheet.
No odometer/ECU mileage readout, VIN, or service record visible.
Photos do not clearly show tamper evidence/seal integrity to confirm.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts.
claims.evidence: General business statement; photos only show one assembly.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: This is seller text only; without new photos/video/test report it cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Exact Porsche engine model/variant is not readable; wrong variant can change compatibility and price.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine/gearbox identification plate or stamped engine code (and/or VIN/part number label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Porsche engine/drivetrain assembly with unknown variant (worst-case compatibility risk).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified remotely; could be faulty or have internal damage.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) plus a sound check, or a mechanic test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be confirmed; could have been repaired before and resealed.
risks.proof: Close-ups of seals/gaskets and bolt heads around the engine cover and key service points (showing whether seals are intact).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly opened/previously repaired (worst-case: unknown internal condition).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/ancillary parts or damage during removal/transport (hoses, sensors, mounts, turbo/lines if applicable).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show all included components laid out (starter, alternator, sensors, manifolds, turbo/lines if present) and any broken parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Transmission/drive compatibility not confirmed (engine may be paired with a specific gearbox/transfer setup).
risks.proof: Photo of gearbox code/label and the mating interface; also show the full assembly type (engine + gearbox) clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only or mismatched pairing risk (worst-case: buyer must verify compatibility).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/identification plate and any part-number stickers (engine + gearbox if included).
Video of the engine starting and running (showing no abnormal noise) or a written test report.
Photos of seals/gaskets and bolt heads around the engine cover to support “never opened.”
A full inventory photo of what is included (all sensors/hoses/ancillaries) and any missing/broken items.
Photo of gearbox/transmission code/label and mating interface to confirm compatibility.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a text assertion of testing; without new remote-verifiable evidence (engine/gearbox codes and a start/run video or test report), the key condition claims remain unverified, so a reliable worst-case price still can’t be set.
